cases.name: deploy-action-inputs-and-server-result
cases.prompt: A provider pinned to terraform-plugin-framework v1.19.0 needs a Terraform action that deploys an application. Users provide an application ID; the remote API returns a deployment ticket and progress updates. Show the action schema and registration, and explain how to report progress and the returned ticket. The provider targets Terraform 1.14 or newer.
cases.trap: Models may reuse managed-resource schema fields (Computed/Default) for actions, or forget ProviderWithActions registration and the action progress API.
expectations: Uses action/schema with supported configurable inputs, not Computed or Default fields for a server-produced ticket.
Registers the action through provider.ProviderWithActions/Actions and uses the public action Invoke/progress API.
Reports the API result/progress without inventing persisted managed-resource state for an action.
must_not: Must not present managed-resource Computed attributes as valid action schema.
